## What task should this prompt handle?

Describe the task or problem someone would use this prompt for.

## Suggested category

Which category from [`docs/taxonomy.md`](../../docs/taxonomy.md) fits best? (Or propose a new one if none fit.)

## Target AI tool(s)

Which AI tools should this work well with? (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Midjourney, an agentic coding tool — leave blank if unsure.)

## Example use case

A short, concrete example of when you'd reach for this prompt.

## Anything else?

Links, references, or existing prompts elsewhere that inspired this request.
